title: Why Is the Sky Blue? (And Why Are Sunsets Orange?)
short_title: Why is the sky blue? The real answer 🌤️ #shorts
description:
Sunlight isn't blue at all… so why is the sky? And why do sunsets turn orange, clouds stay white, and Martian sunsets glow blue? Here is the science of sky colors, step by step.
